item.text: The feed emits its cached packet synchronously from `start()`, but the panel listener is added afterward. I’ll register that listener first, keep telemetry’s delta-only order, and track packet arrival order so a late decode can still enter history without repainting an older frame.
The listener change is in place. I’m checking warm startup, reversed decode completion, retry and navigation, cleanup during a synchronous callback, and telemetry’s existing behavior.

Updated [src/progress.js](/workspace/src/progress.js) so the panel subscribes before the feed emits its cached packet. It also uses packet arrival order to prevent a late decoded frame from moving the display backward; both frames still enter progress history.

Direct Node assertions passed for warm startup, reversed decode completion, retry, navigation, cleanup, and telemetry. The workspace has no test script, so verification was limited to those checks.
